newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian coconut and copra prices fall slightly.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian coconut and copra prices fall slightly.

text.p: Indonesian coconut oil and copra prices fell slightly on Friday in thin buying interest, traders said.
"Coconut oil prices have fallen slightly because of the poor buying interest. The fall in the oil prices have pushed the copra prices down," said one trader in Jakarta.

"But compared with a few months ago, the current prices are still high after the bullish overseas trend encourage traders to export coconut oil. This has led to a kind of tight supply in the local market," he said.
Traders said coconut oil was quoted at 1,380-90 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, against 1,400 rupiah/kg last week. Copra fell to 875 rupiah/kg against 885 rupiah/kg last week.
Some traders attributed the bearish local sentiment to the weak trend in the Philippines.
"The local market sentiment has been affected by the situation in the Philippines, such as the typhoon in March and the recent fighting in Mindanao," a trader said.
Traders said cooking oil, the refined form of coconut oil, fell to 1,580-1,600 rupiah/kg against 1,630 rupiah/kg last week.
They said prices were quoted at $612/tonne against $600/tonne fob Kuala Enok in Riau. One trader said a total of 12,000 tonnes of coconut oil was shipped to Rotterdam on Tuesday.
Traders in Manila said coconut oil prices are expected to slide this week in anticipation of new arrivals of fresh supplies in Rotterdam from Manila and Jakarta.
